name: Diffbot
tagline: Structure the public web into a knowledge graph and extract entities from pages and text
description: Diffbot turns unstructured web content into structured, linked knowledge. Core products: Extract (rule-free page classification and JSON extraction), Knowledge Graph Search/DQL and Enhance (query or enrich entities like people and organizations), Natural Language (entities, facts, sentiment from raw text), and Crawl/Bulk for site-scale jobs. Hosts differ by product: api.diffbot.com (Extract/Crawl), kg.diffbot.com (DQL/Enhance), nl.diffbot.com (NLP).

auth.details: API token as query parameter `token` on GET and POST (created on free self-serve signup at app.diffbot.com; also viewable in Dashboard). Example hosts also accept token on kg.diffbot.com and nl.diffbot.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 10,000 credits/month, all four product APIs, no credit card; Free rate 5 req/min. Free monthly caps: Extract 10k calls, NLP 500 calls, DQL 400 entities, Enhance 400 entities. 429 when quota/rate exceeded; quotas reset each billing period.
pricing.paid_plans: Startup $299/mo (250k credits, overage $0.001/credit, 5 req/s); Plus $899/mo (1M credits, overage $0.0009/credit, Crawl, 25 req/s); Enterprise custom. Credit costs e.g. 1 page extract=1, KG entity export=25, web search=1.

rate_limits: By plan: Free 5 calls/min; Startup 5 calls/sec; Plus 25 calls/sec (Enterprise custom). Free also caps Extract 10k/mo, NLP 500/mo, DQL 400 entities/mo, Enhance 400 entities/mo; Plus Crawl 25 active / 1000 total jobs.
use_cases: extract structured article or product JSON from any public page URL
query the Knowledge Graph with DQL for orgs/people matching filters
extract entities, facts, and relationships from raw text via NLP
enrich a company or person record with public-web KG data (Enhance)
crawl a site and bulk-extract page objects without per-site rules
